newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Troika issues buys on 5 Russian regional utilities.
newsitem.headline: Troika issues buys on 5 Russian regional utilities.

text.p: Russian brokerage Troika Dialog recommends 'buy' on five regional power utilities in an August report on less liquid utility shares.
It said Bashenergo, Permenergo, Chelyabenergo, Novosibirskenergo and unlisted Omskenergo were undervalued in relation to leading shares in the sector, and discounts to preference shares would narrow.

But Troika recommended selling ordinary shares in Rostovenergo RTSE.RTS and holding its preference shares as well as both classes of share in Kolenergo KOLE.RTS, which it said was fairly valued but desirable for its high hydro mix and location.
Price-earnings ratios based on Russian accounting standards were estimated to be below seven for all seven utilities for an average of 6.2 after 8.4 in 1996.
Utility share prices have outperformed the market in the year to date, at 250 percent versus 165 percent for the Moscow Times index, it said.
Troika said sector reforms beginning with national electricity company UES would be beneficial to the industry, improving efficiency and clearing up the nonpayments crisis in Russia.
